AND( $User.Alias <> "sconn",
OR( AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", CFIN_Completed_and_Confirmed__c = TRUE, OR( ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Customer int number assgnmnt - DEBI"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "QioDebitoren Europäische Union - DEEU"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Bill To - H004") ), ISBLANK(PaymentTerm__c) ),
AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Salem/MIA", CFIN_Completed_and_Confirmed__c = TRUE, ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "PAYER Entry - 0003"), ISBLANK(PaymentTerm__c) ),
AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", CFIN_Completed_and_Confirmed__c = TRUE, ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Bill To - 0001"), ISBLANK(PaymentTerm__c) ),
AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Intra-Div & Inter-Co. - ZINT"), ISBLANK(PaymentTerm__c) ) ) )
